details:
A time of new beginnings, leadership, and independence. You will be challenged to stand on your own two feet and take initiative.
Initiative, independence, leadership, and resilience are the key words for this pinnacle cycle energy. Also self-determination, self-sufficiency, and self-reliance.
It is a period of determining what matters for oneself. Alone time tends to be cherished because it means less interference from others.

A time of cooperation, harmony, and relationships. You will be challenged to work with others and develop your diplomatic skills.
Partnerships, associations, intuition, and sensitivity are the key words for this pinnacle cycle. It is a period of relationships — personal, romantic, professional, social.
It is a period of working with others on joint projects. Teamwork resonates especially well, as does finding diplomatic solutions to disagreements or misunderstandings.

A time of creativity, self-expression, and communication. You will be challenged to express your unique talents and share your voice with the world.
Inspiration, imagination, and creative expression are the key words for this pinnacle cycle. Also tolerance, optimism, and social interaction.
It tends to be a stimulating and highly creative period. Also a period where a person tends to inspire and motivate the creativity of others.

A time of hard work, stability, and building foundations. You will be challenged to be practical, organized, and disciplined.
Order, endeavor, responsibility, practicality, and accomplishment are the key words for this pinnacle cycle. Also a secure foundation that will last.
This tends to be a period of building, placing facts and ideas in their proper order, manifesting ideas, and focusing on the security of the future.

A time of freedom, adventure, and change. You will be challenged to embrace new experiences and adapt to the unexpected.
Variety, public life, the unexpected, and opportunities are the key words for this pinnacle cycle. Adventure and conversation, too.
There are likely to be opportunities to travel and meet new and interesting people. Writing and speaking opportunities tend to present themselves.

A time of responsibility, family, and service. You will be challenged to nurture your relationships and care for others.
Responsibility, home, duty, nurturing, and community are key words for this pinnacle cycle. Healing or public service may also be a large focus.
During this cycle, helping those in need — teaching, healing, nurturing — tends to bring satisfaction, especially when helping friends and family.

A time of introspection, wisdom, and spiritual growth. You will be challenged to look within and connect with your deeper self.
Self-examination, poise, knowledge, and an interest in philosophy are the key words for this pinnacle cycle. This tends to be a period of education, both inner development and scientific study.
A person experiencing this cycle number tends to be perceptive and astute and able to analyze problems to find viable solutions. Scientific analysis tends to be an evolving or intrinsic talent.

A time of power, ambition, and material success. You will be challenged to take charge of your career and achieve your goals.
Enterprise, finance, strength, and material acquisition are the key words for this pinnacle cycle. It resonates with sound judgment and vision, authority in the subject of focus.
The person experiencing this cycle energy generally wants to be or is in charge of business, professional activities, or organizations that require a focus on the practical affairs of finances and commercial activity.

A time of compassion, humanitarianism, and global awareness. You will be challenged to make a difference in the world.
Tolerance, creativity, and philanthropy are key words for this pinnacle cycle. Also compassion and humanitarianism.
The resonance of this pinnacle cycle energy resonates with civilization, societies, all people. It is selflessness.
A time of spiritual enlightenment and intuition. You will be challenged to trust your instincts and follow your higher calling.
A time of mastery and large-scale achievement. You will be challenged to build something of lasting value for the world.
